summary: The seven Jenkinsfile.iac-* files are declarative files to the guide: Scheduled Calico Rollout and IaC Docker Image are their reference files as published, and the other five follow the iac-controller reference (Checkout, 4h timeout, plain disableConcurrentBuilds() with the abort marker, no buildDiscarder, POST-2 dev stages, guide labels). All seven pass the controller's linter. Ansible 90d69a0 on phase/036-P9; kc project test --project root green.
